verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no isolated sandbox environment, test mode, or separate workspace that keeps testing apart from production data. Conductor's simulation tests ("check changes without making real phone calls") and the dashboard's free web-call Test button are simulation and dry-run style testing against your agent. They are an adjacent capability, not documented sandbox isolation of production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
